full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE square transparent PNG miniature token for Tales of Maj'Eyal: green worm mass. Request 1024 x 1024 pixels; retain the tool's native resolution and alpha.

Identity brief: A group of several individually visible small segmented green worms, not one snake or one blob. Six to nine somewhat slender worm bodies radiate outward from a loose central tangle; distinct rounded heads and dark gaps show where bodies separate. A few outer bodies bend into short hooks.
Family separation: Existing white worm mass is a compact bright mound of short thick creamy grubs. This green worm mass has an open radial starburst silhouette, longer thinner outer bodies, large dark gaps and darker olive-green overall value. Distinction must survive grayscale and 48px.
Composition: One low physical group on one disc, viewed from high three-quarter overhead. Every worm fully inside rim, no cut ends at boundary. No worm head in upper-right UI margin. Central bodies retain readable broad segments after reduction; avoid fine noisy hairlike strands.

Match the designated style reference's steep overhead three-quarter camera, upper-left soft light, matte painted miniature finish and thin charcoal-brown physical disc with a restrained bronze-grey bevel. The disc occupies about 82% of the canvas width. All anatomy and equipment must remain inside it, with a clear margin. Use broad readable value planes and a crisp silhouette at 48/64/96px; dark bodies need a broad pale rim or lighter facing plane, not tiny glowing outlines. Keep identity-defining features out of the upper-right rank area and upper-left interaction-marker area. Native references establish identity; they do not override the style reference's camera or disc. Do not copy another species from a style reference.

Palette/material: Muted moss and olive greens, yellow-green broad lit upper planes, deep olive segment undersides. Acid is suggested by natural green coloration only: no pools, droplets, poison fog, glow or tactical effect.
True transparent alpha outside the disc; no painted checkerboard. Keep the entire disc in frame and transparent corners. This is a static identity illustration. Add no faction ring, health arc, shield, rank, crown, UI marker, number, text, aura, scene or floor outside the disc. No recolor-only substitute for a different species, no montage and no alternate variants in one image. Anatomy must match the identity brief, including intentional missing limbs.

Reference roles:
Image 1: style — Use the approved high three-quarter overhead camera, matte sculpted fur, dark physical disc and muted copper-grey rim; do not copy its body or tail pose.
Image 2: identity — Native multiple green worms and acid identity; ignore original black background/camera.
Image 3: family — Existing white worm mass: distinguish by radial longer silhouette and darker value, not hue alone.
